description: Use when you know WHAT you need and want the exact request: paying an unknown agent for data or work (arbiter escrow), milestone work, a dispute or veto window, a k-of-n panel, two of three, an atomic swap, recurring or split payments, a performance bond, streams, an x402 seller with a dispute window, checking a counterparty first. Returns a compact list; with id, the exact request and MCP arguments per chain, who does what, what happens on no delivery or a dispute, the trust assumption and the fee. Plans only, public, no signature. Not for micro-payments (use plain x402 exact).

id.description: Optional recipe id from the list, e.g. pay-unknown-agent, milestone-work, dispute-window-optimistic, k-of-n-panel, atomic-swap, dispute-window-x402, check-counterparty. Leave empty to list all.
